_description: T7 fixed-phase L1 test — the MODEL'S OWN orbital histories on a 1-kyr grid over 0 … −5.4 Myr: the one-source movement's construction (banked ±10-Myr engine run + obliquity hybrid on the composed lunisolar torque rate with the precession-of-date factors + physical of-date climatic precession), built once at 1 kyr by the Node shim's createOneSourceTier. Consumer: scripts/t7_fixed_phase_l1.py. Regenerate: node tools/explore/t7-export-orbital-histories.mjs --write

grid.t_axis: years from J2000 (negative = past); kyr BP ≈ −t/1000 (the 50-yr 1950 offset is below the grid)

conventions.eps_deg: obliquity of date, the hybrid (ds/dt = α(ŝ·n̂)(ŝ×n̂) on the banked ζ history, α from the composed lunisolar torque rate × the precession-of-date factors)
conventions.peri_of_date_deg: Earth's perihelion longitude of date from the moving equinox (the physical angle ŝ×n̂ → perihelion in the orbit plane)
conventions.e_sin_peri: e · sin(peri_of_date_deg) — the climatic precession index (Earth's perihelion; the Sun's is +180°, a sign flip)
conventions.q65n_june_wm2: daily-mean insolation at 65°N for solar longitude 90° (June solstice), Berger's form as the simulator's computeDailyInsolationWm2 (perigee = ϖ + 180°), S₀ = 1361 W/m²
